chapter.verse: Tua lai takin mihonpi tam kik a, an nek ding a neih loh uh ciangin Zeisu in a nungzuite sam a,
“Hih mite hehpihhuai ka sa hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, ni thum tawntung kei tawh a omkhawm uh hi. An nek ding a nei kei uh hi.
An ne loin innah ka ciahsak leh, lampi ah a gim ding uh hi.Tuate kimkhat in gamlapi panin hong pai uh hi,” a ci hi.
A nungzuite in, “Hih mite an kham ding bang lak pan kingah thei ding hiam?” a ci uh hi.
Zeisu in, “Khomun pum bangzah na nei uh hiam? ci-in a dot ciangin amaute in, “Pum sagih a om hi,” a ci uh hi.

Tua ciangin Zeisu in, “Mihonpi lei tungah tusak un,’ ci-in a sawl hi. Tua ciangin khomun sagih la a, hehpihna a phat khit ciangin, khomun balnenin mite mai-ah lui dingin a nungzuite a pia hi. A nungzuite in mihonpi a lui uh hi.
Ngasa tawmkha nei uh ahih ciangin, hehpihna a phat khit ciangin, tuate zong mite lui ding thu a pia hi.
Amaute in a ne uh a, a kham khit uh ciangin, a khamval uh a neng a themte tawm uh a, seeng sagih a ngah uh hi.
Tuate tul li bang a pha uh hi.
Zeisu in amaute a paikhiatsak khit ciangin a nungzuite tawh gunkuang tungah thakhatin tuangin, Dalmanutha gam a tung uh hi.
Tua lai takin Farisaite hong pusuak uh a, Zeisu tawh thu a kinial uh ciangin, ze-et nadingin vantung pan lim a ngen uh hi.
Zeisu in a lungsim sungah khuisa a, “Hih khang mite in bang hangin lim a ngen uh hiam? Ke’n aman takpi kong cih-inah, hih khang mite ading lim a kilak kei ding hi,” a ci hi.
Amaute omna pan paikhia a, khatvei gunkuang tungah tuang kikin tui gal khatah a pai hi.
A nungzuite in khomun puak ding a mangngilh uh a, gunkuang tungah khomun pum khat bek a nei uh hi.
Zeisu in, “Farisaite leh Herod’ silnngo kikeem un la, tang un,” a cih ciangin,
a nungzuite in, “Eite in khomun i nei kei hi,” ci-in khat leh khat a kikum uh hi.
Zeisu in a theih ciangin, “Note in khomun na neih loh manun bang hangin khat leh khat na kikum uh hiam? Thei lo lai ngaihsun lo lai na hi uh hiam?
Na lungsim uh khauh khauh lai ahi hiam? Mittang nei napi-in mu lo, bil nei napi-in za lo, phawk lo na hi uh hiam?
Khomun pum nga mi tul nga ading ka balnen ciangin, a neng a them seeng bangzah na tawm uh hiam?” ci-in a dot ciangin, “Seeng sawm leh seeng nih,” a ci uh hi.
“Khomun sagih tul li ading ka balnen ciangin, a neng a themte seeng bangzah na tawm uh hiam?” ci-in a dot ciangin amaute in, “Seeng sagih,” a ci uh hi.
Zeisu in, “Note in thei nai lo na hi uh hiam?” a ci hi.
Amaute in Bethsaida khua-ah a tun’ uh ciangin, mittaw mi khat a kiangah hong paipih uh a, tua pa a lawn’ nadingin a thuum uh hi.
Zeisu in mittawpa a khut tawh kai a, khua nawlah a paipih khit ciangin, a mittang cil phih a, a tungah khut a ngak khit ciangin, “Na khatpeuh peuh na mu thei hiam?” ci-in a dong hi.
Amah a ettoh leh, “Mite ka mu hi; amaute singkung pai bangin ka mu hi,” a ci hi.
Tua lai takin Zeisu in a khut khatvei a mittang ah nga kik a, tua pa in tel takpi a et kik ciangin dam a, na khempeuh tel takin a mu thei hi.
Zeisu in tua pa innah ciahsak a, “Khua sungah na lut kei in,” ci-in thu a pia hi.
Zeisu in a nungzuite tawh Kaisaria Filippi gam khua neute-ah a pai uh hi. Lampi-ah a pai lai takun, “Mite in kei kua hi hong ci uh hiam?” ci-in a nungzuite a dong hi.
Amaute in, “Baptaizpa Johan,” a ci uh hi. Kimkhat in, ‘Elijah,’ a ci uh hi. Ahih hangin midang kimkhat in, ‘Kamsangpa khatpeuh,’ a ci ciat uh hi,” ci-in a gen uh hi.
Zeisu in, “Note in kei kua mi hi nong ci uh hiam?” ci-in a dot ciangin, Piter in, “Nangmah in Khazih na hi hi,” a ci hi.
Amah kua mi ahi ci-in kuamah kiangah gen lo dingin a nungzuite a kham hi.

Zeisu in, “Mihing Tapa in gimna tampi thuak ding a, upate, siampi liante, leh laitheite in nial ding uh a, amah in thahna thuakin ni thum khit ciangin a thokik ding hi,” ci-in tua a kipanin a nungzuite a hilh hi.
Tua thu im loin a gen khin hi. Piter in Zeisu samsim a, seel ding a kipat ciangin,
Zeisu kihei a, a nungzuite a muh ciangin, “Satan aw, ka nungah kinkhia in; nang in Pasian thu na ngaihsun kei hi, mite thu bek na ngaihsun hi,” ci-in Piter a taai hi.
Tua ciangin Zeisu in a nungzuite leh mihonpite a sap khit ciangin, “Mi khatpeuh in kei hong zuih nop leh, ama pumpi nial a, a singlamteh pua-in hong zui ta hen.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, ama nuntakna a gum nuamte in a nuntakna a mangthangsak ding hi. Kei hang ahi zongin, Lungdamna Thu hang ahi zongin nuntakna a mangsakte in a nuntakna a gum ding hi.
Mi khat in leitung khempeuh a ngah hangin, ama nuntakna mangthangsak leh, bang phattuamna ngah ding ahi hiam?
Mi khatpeuh in ama nuntakna bang sum tawh lei kik thei ding ahi hiam?

Mi paktat leh gilo hih khang mite lakah, kei ahi zongin, ka thu ahi zongin a daisak peuhmah Mihing Tapa in zong a Pa minthan’na leh a siangtho vantungmite tawh hong paikhawm uh ciangin, tua mite a daisak ding hi.”
